hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { read -r CMD; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^gh pr (merge|create)'; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if echo "$BRANCH" | grep -qE '^(feat|chore|fix)/phase-'; then if [ ! -f '.phase-audit-complete' ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CONSTITUTIONAL VIOLATION (Priority 0.5): .phase-audit-complete artifact missing. The phase-boundary-auditor MUST run before any phase PR is created or merged. Create this file by running the auditor."}}'; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f '.spec-challenge-complete' ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CONSTITUTIONAL VIOLATION (Rule 20): .spec-challenge-complete artifact missing. The spec-challenger MUST run before phase development begins. Create this file after the spec-challenger completes."}}'; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f '.reviewers-complete' ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CONSTITUTIONAL VIOLATION (Rule 21/23): .reviewers-complete artifact missing. All required reviewers (QA + DevOps + Balance + conditional Arch/Visual) MUST run before PR creation. Create this file after all reviewers complete."}}'; exit 0; fi; fi; fi; echo '{}'; }
